A broken, wet or dusty headphone jack can make the phone believe headphones are plugged in, which mutes the speaker. This app disables the headphone output in software and sends all sound to the phone's own speaker. No root needed.

• Android 6–8: media audio is forced straight to the speaker.
• Android 9 and newer + Shizuku: media audio is forced straight to the speaker at normal quality. Install Shizuku, start it with "Wireless debugging" and grant this app permission.
• Android 8 and newer (without Shizuku): the phone is put into "communication mode" with the speaker selected. In this mode the volume keys change the call volume; media volume is capped by it, so the volume keys still make things louder.
• Add the "Disable Headphone" tile to Quick Settings to toggle it with one tap.
• While running, a notification is shown; tap "Stop" to go back to normal.
When a headphone is detected, sound is moved to the speaker automatically.
